question: What proportional measure of the liṅga diameter is specified as an alternative?
premises: A liṅga has a given diameter.
A proportional measure is being specified.
The measure is one eighth part as an alternative.
inference: For whichever liṅga, the measure may be one eighth of its diameter, or alternatively so.
uncertainties: The sentence continues into the next verse, so the full predicate is incomplete here.
plain_english: For whichever liṅga, the diameter may be taken as one eighth part, or alternatively so.
